description: This PHP class 'RecruitmentAttachmentDao' provides data access methods for managing recruitment-related attachments such as vacancy, candidate, and interview attachments within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and listing attachments, as well as filtering based on various criteria.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling recruitment attachment entities such as vacancy, candidate, and interview attachments, providing CRUD operations and complex queries.

methods.name: saveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Persists a VacancyAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Persists a CandidateAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Persists an InterviewAttachment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a VacancyAttachment by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing vacancy attachment IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: getPartialCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial RecruitmentAttachment for a candidate by candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves a CandidateAttachment entity by candidate ID.

methods.name: hasCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Checks if a candidate has any attachment by candidate ID.

methods.name: getPartialInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial RecruitmentAttachment for an interview attachment by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves an InterviewAttachment entity by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Retrieves all vacancy attachments associated with a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsCountByVacancyId
methods.description: Counts the number of attachments for a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: deleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple vacancy attachments by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Deletes candidate attachment(s) by candidate ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves interview attachments based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for interview attachments based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentsCount
methods.description: Counts interview attachments matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all interview attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all vacancy attachment IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves attachment IDs for vacancies managed by a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves attachment IDs for interviews related to vacancies managed by a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves attachment IDs for interviews accessible to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Helper method to get interview IDs accessible to an interviewer.

methods.name: getExistingInterviewAttachmentIdsForInterview
methods.description: Returns existing interview attachment IDs for a specific interview.

methods.name: deleteInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Deletes interview attachments by IDs for a specific interview.
